title: Turn a validated AI niche into a priced offer and funnel
purpose: Verify that offer building names buyer, pain, price, lead magnet, funnel, and reject criteria.
prompt: Create a priced offer and funnel for a validated niche: AI content repurposing system for Polish creators and Skool community owners.
expected_behaviors: Defines a specific buyer and painful workflow.
Includes pricing options and value logic.
Defines lead magnet, landing page structure, and sales questions.
failure_patterns: Has no disqualifiers or validation test.
judge_notes: Passing output must include one-sentence offer, 3 pricing options, and first sales-call script.
